summary: Building a workflow: open the visualizer, Add step, choose a node type; nodes without a default inventory use the workflow's, templates with password credentials cannot be added unless prompted; edge types are Always (fixed for root), Run on success and Run on fail, and Convergence is Any (default) or All.
questions: How do I add a node in the workflow visualizer?
What is the difference between Any and All convergence?
Why can't I add my job template to a workflow?
What edge types exist in controller workflows?
Which inventory does a workflow node use if the job template has none?

answer_card.title: Workflow edge types and convergence
answer_card.answer_md:
**Edge type** (how a node is triggered from its parent):
- *Always run*: regardless of success or failure (root nodes are always *Always*)
- *Run on success*
- *Run on fail*

**Convergence** (node with several parents):
- *Any* (default): runs once all parents finish and at least one meets its run condition
- *All*: runs only if every parent meets its expected outcome; shown as *ALL* in the graph
